speaker_wall_mount.label: Speaker wall mount
speaker_wall_mount.description: Wall bracket for a satellite speaker with a ball joint and a screw-on adapter ring.

hinge_test_plate.label: Hinge tolerance plate
hinge_test_plate.description: Print-in-place hinge sample plate for dialling in the joint clearance before printing a cabinet door.

shower_rail_mount.label: Shower rail mount
shower_rail_mount.description: Screw-on bracket that clamps a shower curtain rail against the bathroom wall.

curtain_rod_cap.label: Curtain rod end cap
curtain_rod_cap.description: Push-on end cap that closes the open end of a curtain rod, with a rounded cap face.

concrete_cylinder_mold.label: Concrete cylinder mold
concrete_cylinder_mold.description: Two-piece split mold for casting an ASTM C39 concrete test cylinder, bolted shut around a clamping flange.

honeycomb_concrete_mold.label: Honeycomb concrete mold
honeycomb_concrete_mold.description: Honeycomb mold that casts a cluster of small concrete cylinders at once, aligned by skewer rods.

cabinet_hinge.label: Print-in-place cabinet hinge
cabinet_hinge.description: Parametric print-in-place cabinet hinge with interleaved fingers, countersunk screw holes and a printed pin.

parameters.label: Fingers
parameters.help: Must be odd so the two leaves interleave.

mounting_plate.label: Mounting plate
mounting_plate.description: Rounded mounting plate with four slotted screw holes, for switches, sockets and wall anchors.

geometry_platonic_solids.label: Platonic Solids Set
geometry_platonic_solids.description: The five Platonic solids - tetrahedron, cube, octahedron, dodecahedron and icosahedron - laid out on one bed so a class can compare their faces, edges and vertices.

parameters.label: Circumradius
parameters.help: Radius of the sphere that touches every vertex; also drives the width of the cube.

parameters.label: Spacing
parameters.help: Gap between the solids as a multiple of the size; 1.2 leaves room to cut them apart.

presets.name: Close-packed
presets.description: Tighter ring for a small print bed.

geometry_solid_edges.label: Platonic Solid by Edge
geometry_solid_edges.description: One Platonic solid sized by its edge length instead of its circumradius, so several solids can be printed with edges that line up exactly.

parameters.label: Edge length
parameters.help: Length of one edge of the chosen solid.

parameters.label: Solid
parameters.help: Which of the four solids to build.

geometry_platonic_net.label: Platonic Solid Net
geometry_platonic_net.description: A flat folding net for any of the five Platonic solids, with living hinges along the fold lines so the printed net folds up into the solid.

parameters.label: Solid
parameters.help: The Schlafli symbol follows from this count.

parameters.label: Edge length
parameters.help: Edge of each face; the whole net scales with it.

parameters.label: Face height
parameters.help: Height of the truncated pyramidal faces before folding.

parameters.label: Hinge thickness
parameters.help: Thickness of the living hinge; thinner folds more easily.

presets.name: Thicker hinges
presets.description: A stiffer net for small hands.

geometry_meissner_tetrahedron.label: Meissner Tetrahedron
geometry_meissner_tetrahedron.description: A solid of constant width built by rounding the edges of a tetrahedron: either Meissner body or the plain Reuleaux tetrahedron that is not quite constant width.

parameters.label: Sphere radius
parameters.help: Radius of the three spherical surfaces that form the solid.

parameters.label: Body
parameters.help: Type 1 and 2 are the true solids of constant width.

geometry_reuleaux_polygon.label: Reuleaux Polygon
geometry_reuleaux_polygon.description: A Reuleaux polygon of constant width with the matching enclosure, so the roller and the hole it fits show that a curve of constant width need not be a circle.

parameters.label: Width
parameters.help: Constant width of the polygon across its flat sides.

parameters.label: Sides
parameters.help: Reuleaux polygons need an odd number of sides.

parameters.label: Height
parameters.help: Printed height of the roller and its enclosure.

parameters.label: Wall
parameters.help: Thickness of the enclosure walls.

parameters.label: Base
parameters.help: Solid floor left under both parts.

parameters.label: Clearance
parameters.help: Gap between the roller and the enclosure.

geometry_sundial_gnomon.label: Sundial Gnomon
geometry_sundial_gnomon.description: The triangular shadow caster for a horizontal sundial, angled for the observer latitude so its edge is parallel to the Earth axis and the hour lines come out even.

parameters.label: Base length
parameters.help: Length of the triangle along the dial plate.

parameters.label: Foot width
parameters.help: Width of the foot that stands on the plate.

parameters.label: Latitude
parameters.help: Observer latitude; the sign selects the hemisphere.

parameters.label: Thickness
parameters.help: Thickness of the printed plate.

presets.name: Tropic
presets.description: Cut for the Tropic of Cancer.

rocket_nose_cone.label: Rocket Nose Cone (Haack)
rocket_nose_cone.description: A Haack-series model rocket nose cone on a short cylindrical shoulder: pick the von Karman, LV-Haack or any in-between profile with the drag factor.

parameters.label: Body diameter
parameters.help: Outside diameter of the body tube the cone fits.

parameters.label: Total length
parameters.help: Length of the shoulder plus the curved nose.

parameters.label: Shoulder length
parameters.help: Straight cylindrical section that slides into the tube.

parameters.label: Haack factor
parameters.help: 0 is the von Karman (LD-Haack) shape and 0.35 is the LV-Haack shape.

parameters.label: Resolution
parameters.help: Facets around the cone; lower prints faster.

rocket_nose_cone_biconic.label: Rocket Nose Cone (Biconic)
rocket_nose_cone_biconic.description: A biconic nose cone built from two stacked cones, with a narrow pointed tip over a wide base cone for a simple low-drag student rocket.

parameters.label: Body diameter
parameters.help: Base diameter that matches the body tube.

parameters.label: Tip diameter
parameters.help: Diameter where the two cones meet.

parameters.label: Tip length
parameters.help: Length of the narrow tip cone.

parameters.label: Base length
parameters.help: Length of the wide base cone.

parameters.label: Resolution
parameters.help: Facets around the cone; lower prints faster.

rocket_gimbal_test_stand.label: Rocket Gimbal Test Stand
rocket_gimbal_test_stand.description: A truncated cone stand that cradles a rocket motor mount on gimbal screws for thrust-vector tests, with cut-outs for the servo arms and screw holes in the base.

parameters.label: Motor mount
parameters.help: Inside diameter that grips the motor mount tube.

parameters.label: Stand height
parameters.help: Height of the cone above the base flange.

parameters.label: Base screw holes
parameters.help: Drill four screw holes through the base flange.

presets.name: No base holes
presets.description: Clamp or glue it down instead.

telescope_spider_120.label: Telescope Spider, 3-Vane
telescope_spider_120.description: The three-vane hub of a Newtonian secondary-mirror spider, cut from a round disc with clearance for the collimation screws.

parameters.label: Outer diameter
parameters.help: Diameter of the round hub.

parameters.label: Hub height
parameters.help: Thickness of the hub along the optical axis.

parameters.label: Centre hole
parameters.help: Clearance hole for the central mirror-holder screw.

parameters.label: Vane hole depth
parameters.help: Depth of the through holes that take the vane rods.

parameters.label: Cut-out fillet
parameters.help: Radius of the rounded corners of the three cut-outs.

parameters.label: Vane spacing
parameters.help: Gap between the two parallel vanes of each arm.

telescope_spider_90.label: Telescope Spider, 4-Vane
telescope_spider_90.description: The four-vane hub of a Newtonian secondary-mirror spider, cut from a square block with round collimation reliefs in every corner.

parameters.label: Hub size
parameters.help: Width of the square hub block.

parameters.label: Hub height
parameters.help: Thickness of the hub along the optical axis.

parameters.label: Centre hole
parameters.help: Clearance hole for the central mirror-holder screw.

parameters.label: Vane hole depth
parameters.help: Depth of the through holes that take the vane rods.

parameters.label: Corner relief
parameters.help: Radius of the rounded relief at each corner.

parameters.label: Vane spacing
parameters.help: Gap between the two parallel vanes of each arm.

telescope_tube_ring.label: Telescope Tube Ring
telescope_tube_ring.description: A clamp ring that bolts a telescope tube onto an equatorial mount, with a dovetail foot, hinge ear and axial screw holes.

parameters.label: Tube diameter
parameters.help: Outside diameter of the telescope tube it clamps.

parameters.label: Ring width
parameters.help: Wall thickness added around the tube.

parameters.label: Ring height
parameters.help: Width of the ring along the tube axis.

presets.name: 146 mm tube
presets.description: The default ring for a 146 mm tube.

presets.name: 100 mm tube
presets.description: A ring for an 80 mm refractor.

microscope_filter_holder.label: Microscope Filter Holder
microscope_filter_holder.description: A 45 mm filter holder that drops into a Nikon Diaphot TMD stage frame, with a recessed glass seat and a barbed seat for a gel filter.

parameters.label: Glass diameter
parameters.help: Diameter of the round filter or glass.

parameters.label: Glass thickness
parameters.help: Thickness of the glass, used for the seat depth.

parameters.label: Holder thickness
parameters.help: Thickness of the holder through the optics.

microscope_objective_holder.label: Microscope Objective Holder
microscope_objective_holder.description: The tapered universal objective holder that sits in the Nikon Diaphot TMD stage frame, with slide pockets, a dish recess and a support lip.

parameters.label: Frame span
parameters.help: Inner span of the microscope stage frame it slides into.

parameters.label: Holder depth
parameters.help: Front-to-rear depth of the holder.

parameters.label: Plate height
parameters.help: Height of the holder plate above the frame.

microscope_holder_clamp.label: Microscope Stage Clamp
microscope_holder_clamp.description: The universal objective holder fitted with spring clamp tabs that grip the Nikon Diaphot TMD stage frame so it cannot slide while focusing.

parameters.label: Frame span
parameters.help: Inner span of the microscope stage frame it clips onto.

parameters.label: Holder depth
parameters.help: Front-to-rear depth of the holder.

parameters.label: Plate height
parameters.help: Height of the holder plate above the frame.

parameters.label: Tab thickness
parameters.help: Thickness of the clamp tabs above the plate.

presets.name: Taller tabs
presets.description: A firmer grip on the frame.

equatorial_sundial.label: Equatorial Sundial
equatorial_sundial.description: A latitude-adjustable equatorial sundial with an embossed hour ring, a support arc and a base disc, showing how a gnomon parallel to the Earth axis reads solar time.

parameters.label: Latitude
parameters.help: Observer latitude; the sign selects the hemisphere.

parameters.label: Longitude
parameters.help: Observer longitude, used for the hour offset.

parameters.label: Ring radius
parameters.help: Inner radius of the hour annulus.

parameters.label: Ring width
parameters.help: Radial width of the hour ring.

parameters.label: Segments
parameters.help: Number of hour segments around the ring.

parameters.label: Number size
parameters.help: Height of the embossed hour numbers.

sundial_analemma.label: Sundial Analemma Groove
sundial_analemma.description: The figure-of-eight analemma groove for an equatorial sundial, shown cut into a demo slab so the equation of time can be traced as the year passes.

parameters.label: Projection radius
parameters.help: Radius the analemma is projected onto.

parameters.label: Groove width
parameters.help: Width of the cut groove.

parameters.label: Groove depth
parameters.help: Depth of the cut groove.

parameters.label: Slab thickness
parameters.help: Thickness of the demo slab the groove is cut into.

presets.name: Demo slab
presets.description: The default slab with the groove.

astro_dovetail_bar.label: Telescope Dovetail Bar
astro_dovetail_bar.description: A Losmandy-style dovetail bar that bolts to a telescope tube and clamps into a mount saddle, with the tapered sides cut to the standard profile.

parameters.label: Bar length
parameters.help: Length of the dovetail bar; the variable keeps the upstream spelling.

presets.name: 200 mm bar
presets.description: A longer bar for a bigger tube.

astro_dovetail_saddle.label: Telescope Dovetail Saddle
astro_dovetail_saddle.description: The dovetail saddle that clamps a telescope bar onto an equatorial mount, with a knurled locking knob and a tapered dovetail channel.

parameters.label: Saddle width
parameters.help: Width of the dovetail channel.

parameters.label: Saddle thickness
parameters.help: Overall thickness of the saddle block.

parameters.label: Upper cut width
parameters.help: Width of the upper dovetail cut.

parameters.label: Lower cut width
parameters.help: Width of the lower dovetail cut.

parameters.label: Dovetail lip
parameters.help: Thickness of the lip the bar slides behind.

periodic_table_model.label: 3D Periodic Table
periodic_table_model.description: Paul Giguere's three-dimensional periodic table, printed as one teaching model with every element block labelled and arranged by orbital block.

parameters.label: Block width
parameters.help: Width of each element block.

parameters.label: Block height
parameters.help: Height of each element block.

parameters.label: Block depth
parameters.help: Depth of each element block.

parameters.label: Vertical gap
parameters.help: Gap between element blocks vertically.

parameters.label: Horizontal gap
parameters.help: Gap between element blocks horizontally.

parameters.label: Text size
parameters.help: Height of the element symbols.

parameters.label: Text relief
parameters.help: How far the symbols stand off the blocks.

parameters.label: Core thickness
parameters.help: Thickness of the connecting core wall.
